featureName: Turning a goal into a living plan
headline: Samira reaches the real sign-in surface after seeing prompt-to-plan, timeline, prioritization, reflection, collaboration, and MCP access as one adaptable system.
overview: A live product-level walk for Plan Quest, framed around Samira Nasser's actual decision rather than a list of routes.
targetAudience: Is balancing a professional transition with family and study commitments. She needs to see trade-offs and revise dates without rebuilding the plan, not another static task list.

steps.title: The job is a plan that survives change
steps.description: The promise names the failure mode Samira recognizes: goals keep changing shape after the first burst of motivation.

steps.title: Three real planning problems anchor the tour
steps.description: Broad goals, changing plans, and lost momentum are presented as separate situations rather than one generic productivity pitch.

steps.title: Changing plans is treated as normal
steps.description: The active scenario shifts to rebalancing as dates, capacity, and energy change—the core behavior of a living plan.

steps.title: The system spans creation through reflection
steps.action: Moved to the complete feature set.
steps.description: Prompt planning, timeline, priorities, progress, notes, reflection, teamwork, and bring-your-own AI are visible as one connected workflow.
steps.screenshotAlt: Plan Quest planning and reflection feature system

steps.title: The next step is the real product gate
steps.description: The authenticated workspace offers Google, GitHub, email, and Twitter sign-in. No account is created during this evidence run.

keyFeatures: Generate a plan from a prompt
